name: mobile-library-stops
title: Mobile library stops
description: Locations, routes, timetables, and stop frequencies for mobile library vehicles.

fields.name: local_authority
fields.title: Local authority
fields.description: Local authority responsible for the library service

fields.name: local_authority_code
fields.title: Local authority code
fields.description: Official Government Statistical Service (GSS/ONS) 9-character code for the local authority

fields.name: mobile_name
fields.title: Mobile name
fields.description: A name for the mobile library vehicle or service point

fields.name: route
fields.title: Route
fields.description: A name for the route e.g. Route B

fields.name: community
fields.title: Community
fields.description: The community served by the stop e.g. village or town name

fields.name: geox
fields.title: GeoX (Longitude)
fields.description: X coordinate (e.g. longitude) for stop location in decimal degrees

fields.name: geoy
fields.title: GeoY (Latitude)
fields.description: Y coordinate (e.g. latitude) for stop location in decimal degrees

fields.name: day
fields.title: Day
fields.description: The day of the week the mobile library visits this stop

fields.name: type
fields.title: Type
fields.description: The type of stop this is

fields.name: arrival
fields.title: Arrival time
fields.description: The time the mobile library arrives at the stop in 24-hour HH:MM format

fields.name: departure
fields.title: Departure time
fields.description: The time the mobile library departs the stop in 24-hour HH:MM format

fields.name: frequency
fields.title: Frequency
fields.description: The schedule for repeated visits to this stop in iCal Recurrence Rule format

fields.name: start
fields.title: Start date
fields.description: The start date for this stop and timetable

fields.name: end
fields.title: End date
fields.description: The end date for this stop and timetable

fields.name: exceptions
fields.title: Exceptions
fields.description: Comma separated list of ISO-8601 dates (e.g. YYYY-MM-DD) on which this stop is not visited (for example bank holidays or maintenance days)

fields.name: timetable
fields.title: Timetable link
fields.description: A link to a web page, or PDF for the stop, route, mobile or service timetable
